title: Bond yield dynamics: a multi-country multi-horizon string model
abstract: arXiv:2611.26466v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This article extends the forward rate curve model of Baaquie and Bouchaud (2004) and Le Coz and Bouchaud (2024) to the multi-country setting of government bond markets. Cross-country blocks of correlation matrices of realized yield changes are found to display significant asymmetry between maturities. In the framework of the proposed model, this amounts to give to each country an idiosyncratic time scale. Each time scale describes how the perceived time between future dates depends on the dates themselves. The differences between these time scales structure the interactions between curves and reproduce the characteristic asymmetry of cross-country correlation matrices. The proposed model captures the full set of cross-curve correlations simultaneously at both daily and intra-day frequencies. When calibrated on government bonds issued by nine countries of the euro-zone, the typical reconstruction error is 1.7%.

translated_title: 债券收益率动态：多国多期限的弦模型
translated_abstract: 本文将Baaquie和Bouchaud（2004）以及Le Coz和Bouchaud（2024）提出的远期利率曲线模型扩展到多国政府债券市场的情境中。研究发现，已实现收益率变化相关矩阵中的跨国块在期限之间表现出显著的不对称性。在所提出模型的框架下，这相当于赋予每个国家一个特有的时间尺度。每个时间尺度描述了未来日期之间被感知的时间间隔如何依赖于日期本身。这些时间尺度之间的差异构建了收益率曲线之间的相互作用，并重现了跨国相关矩阵的特征性不对称。所提出的模型能够同时在日频和日内频率上捕捉全部跨曲线相关性。当以欧元区九个国家发行的政府债券进行校准时，典型的重构误差为1.7%。
tldr: 该论文将远期利率曲线弦模型扩展到多国国债市场，通过为每个国家引入特有的时间尺度来刻画并重现跨国相关矩阵中的期限不对称性，模型可同时捕捉日频和日内频率的全部跨曲线相关性，在欧元区九国债券上的典型重构误差仅为1.7%。
en_tdlr: The paper extends the string model of forward rate curves to a multi-country government bond setting, where idiosyncratic time scales assigned to each country reproduce the maturity asymmetry in cross-country correlation matrices and enable the model to capture the full set of cross-curve correlations at both daily and intra-day frequencies, achieving a typical reconstruction error of 1.7% when calibrated on euro-zone bonds from nine countries.
